name: Ru Kiln
ability: Once per round, when you complete an Order using a Masterpiece with Celadon Glaze and Plain Decoration, gain 4 VP. The Order itself does not need to require Masterpiece, Celadon or Plain; the delivered ceramic must actually have those attributes.
abilityZh: 每轮一次，当你完成委托时，若使用了一件臻品、青釉、素面陶瓷，获得4 VP。该委托本身不必要求臻品、青釉或素面；实际交付的陶瓷拥有这些属性即可。

name: Guan Kiln
ability: Once per round, when you complete an Order showing at least 1 Crown, gain 2 Coins and 1 VP.
abilityZh: 每轮一次，当你完成一张带有至少1个 👑 的委托时，获得2铜钱和1 VP。

name: Ge Kiln
ability: When completing Orders or scoring the Exhibition, treat your Standard-quality Crackle ceramics as Fine. Once per round: When completing an Order, you may treat 1 of your Crackle ceramics used as having any one Decoration for all that Order’s Decoration requirements. Its actual Decoration stays Crackle.
abilityZh: 完成委托或进行展览计分时，将你的良品开片陶瓷视为上品。每轮一次：完成委托时，可将所用1件开片陶瓷视为具有任意一种纹饰，适用于该委托全部纹饰要求。其实际纹饰仍为开片。

name: Ding Kiln
ability:
Once per round, when resolving a Potter’s Wheel action, after you form a Bowl, Plate or Brush Washer, you may pay 1 Clay to form one additional vessel of the same Shape.
This additional vessel does not count against that action's normal vessel limit and does not count as a vessel formed by the worker effect for the Shifu's two-vessel discount.
abilityZh:
每轮一次，在结算陶车坊行动时，当你成型一个碗、盘或笔洗后，可以支付1泥，额外成型1件相同器型的器物。
该额外器物不计入本行动的正常器物数量上限，也不计入师傅两件器物折扣所要求的工人效果成型数量。

name: Jun Kiln
ability: Once per round, after Actual Heat is calculated but before Quality is assigned, you may pay 1 Wood to adjust the Actual Heat of one of your ceramics by +1 or −1.
abilityZh: 每轮一次，在计算实际火候后、决定品质前，你可以支付1柴，将自己1件陶瓷的实际火候调整+1或−1。
